sources.citation: game-design: a nut driver drives screws with no torque setting, like a plain screwdriver, and with no conductor size limit.

A 5/16 in nut driver fits the head of a #10 hex-washer-head screw, common on boxes, panels and ground screws (hex-washer-head dimensions per ASME B18.6.3, cited by number, unverified). Only the hex drive is modelled; the size is a name.
